title: Working at Tessl: Petra's Story
description:
What does startup life really feel like? At Tessl, it's an experience like no other: dynamic growth, rich collaboration, and a work culture that truly inspires. Forget the Sunday scaries — every week promises something new and exciting. It sounds ideal. It's real.

Petra shares her time at Tessl, an AI startup where she's been trusted with far more than she initially expected. Her journey involves collaborating with some of the sharpest minds in a vibrant and challenging field. From bi-annual offsites in Mallorca and Barcelona to an energetic office atmosphere at King's Cross, Petra's story highlights a unique workplace environment.

What Petra talks about:
• How Tessl provides the freedom and trust to expand beyond expectations
• What makes the team's mix of talent and low ego a compelling reason to join
• What do Tessl's bi-annual offsites in Mallorca and Barcelona entail?
• Life in a 10,000 sq ft workspace in King's Cross
• Why being a people person is perfect for a forward-thinking AI startup
